contact_points — DRIVE locomotion op

• Data kinds: points × any → points

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.contact_points(points, plane, tol: 'float' = 0.02) (to call the implementation directly, import locomotion; locomotion.contact_points(points, plane, tol: 'float' = 0.02); from the registry, opsdrive.get("contact_points"))

• Return value through the ledger: fullseye.ledger.contact_points(...) returns only the declared out type points (the underlying function also returns auxiliary values). When you need what was dropped, use fullseye.ledger.contact_points.raw(...) or call locomotion.contact_points directly.

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Points lying within *tol* of a ground plane [a,b,c,d] = ground contacts.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Given a cloud and the fitted ground plane (see pcseg.fit_plane_ransac), returns (contacts (M,3), mask) — the feet/wheels/base actually touching the floor, the input to support_polygon.

空の入力(points が 0 要素)は(0, 3) の点と空の maskを返す(理由: 点が無ければ接地点も無い。拒否すると逐次の処理が止まる)。
